RK_CARDS.al: A line that shoots up into a sharp spike, then drops right back down
RK_CARDS.p: Porn sets off the brain’s reward system fast and hard, especially when it is new. That is why the pull felt so urgent, and why it was over so quickly. A strong habit does not make you a weak person. Habits can be retrained.

RK_CARDS.h: The crash is a wave too.
RK_CARDS.al: A line that dips low, then climbs back up toward a rising sun
RK_CARDS.p: The flat, heavy feeling afterward is very common. It feels like the truth about you. It is not. It is a mood, and it usually eases with sleep and time.

RK_CARDS.al: From one slip, two paths. “I blew it” leads on to more. “Just one slip” leads back on track.
RK_CARDS.p: That thought is the real danger. Researchers call it the abstinence violation effect: one slip turns into “might as well keep going.” Now you know its name. One slip is just one slip.
RK_CARDS.fact: Being kind to yourself works. In studies, people who met a mistake with kindness tried harder to do better next time, not less.
